body:
Implement a distinct Facet bot under experiments/Facet following specification v1 (2026-11-04). This issue records the prospective hypothesis before gameplay measurement: an independently implemented contextual gun ensemble and engine-native two-wave movement may meet the specification's engineering screen gates. No competitive improvement is asserted.

Source separation: a fresh implementer receives only a filesystem-filtered workspace, supplied specification, official pinned API/engine contracts, independently constructed fixtures and legal energy traces. Original checkout, archives, models and source-derived diagnostics are inaccessible. The implementation process has no GitHub/network source access. Production AISurvivor and reserved experiments remain untouched.

Staging: first establish chronology, motion/fire contracts and semantic matrix; then freeze source/JAR/config/rules/opponent/runtime identities and obtain separate premeasurement review. No performance collection until those gates pass. Full reproducible pins, seed availability, seat order and learning policy must be attached before collection; this draft issue is not a frozen acquisition authorization.

Proposed first budget is exactly 200 rounds: three cold 20-round games each against pinned Diamond Port, Retcon and Adaptive Prime (180), plus two cold 5-round games against each of pinned Target and Walls (20). Learning persists within a game only. Pair seats where supported; record uncontrolled server seeds/scheduling. No tuning midway, no automatic rerun or confirmation after failure. No offline dataset or parameter search.

Unchanged screen gates: all games valid; no numerical failures or unhandled exceptions; skips below 0.5% and combined wall/bot collisions below 1% of bot turns per opponent cohort; mean equal-game score share >40% against Diamond and Retcon and >=50% against Adaptive and both samples. Any failure rejects promotion. Report every whole-game result, official first places, learning curves, damage, confirmed shots/hits, collision/skip counts, range, scan age, subsystem latency/GC and all invalid acquisitions. Synthetic fixtures establish semantics only.

Independent review must check provenance, legal inputs, exact engine semantics, lifecycle, numerical/work/memory bounds, source/JAR parity and required CI. Implementer must not merge its PR. Melee activation follows duel correctness and review and requires its own prospective screen. Evidence/report links and candidate hashes will be added after build; no battles have run.
